prs.description: fail_on_changes no longer breaks the hook when a submodule is staged.
first-time CLI configure asks for the goose mode and saves it.
fine-tune warns when predictions collapse to the class prior.
the session history limit is no longer sent as the Conversations API page size.
lightningcss-loader stops mutating user options, so child compilers build again.
G102 now flags binding to the IPv6 unspecified address.
listenKeys fires for deep keys changed through a parent key.
flags combo steps pinned to models that disappeared from the synced catalog.
optional cleanup of those steps after a model sync.
cleanup of a locked snapshot is retried instead of crashing the background task.
queued scoped mutations start again while the window is unfocused.
